story.title: Lovable launches vibe-coding app on iOS and Android, bringing AI web development to mobile
story.summary: Lovable has launched its AI-powered 'vibe coding' application on both iOS and Android, allowing developers and non-technical users to build web apps and websites directly from a mobile device using natural language prompts. The app extends Lovable's browser-based platform to mobile, targeting a fast-growing segment of developers who want to prototype and build on the go. The launch reflects a broader industry trend of making AI-assisted software creation accessible without traditional coding skills.
